Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Redwood Inference & Lumina Tech)

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Lumina's annotation pipeline and real-time inference requirements. Quick recap and suggested next steps below.
\Highlights from our call:
- Goals: reduce per-request latency for real-time scoring from ~400ms to <150ms; support bursty traffic during peak analytics runs.
- Top constraints: data residency for PII logs, expected throughput ~500 req/s at peak, budget sensitivity for inference spend.
- Success criteria: end-to-end 99th percentile latency under 200ms and token cost reduction of 30% vs current infra.

What Redwood can offer (recap):
- Dedicated GPU pools with autoscaling to handle bursts and guaranteed isolation for sensitive datasets.
- Prefix/KV caching and batching to cut per-token unit cost while keeping latency SLOs.
- Private deployment option and KMS-integrations for compliance.

Proposed next steps:
1) Share a short proof-of-concept (2-week) plan and bill of materials for a Dedicated pilot (I attached a one-pager).
2) Technical deep-dive with your infra lead to scope network/KMS needs (30–45m).
3) Pricing/contract touchpoint with procurement to outline committed capacity options.
\I've attached the discovery slides and a one-page pilot outline: Discovery_Slides_Redwood-Lumina.pdf
\Can you confirm which week next week works for the technical deep-dive? I have availability:
- Tue 8/11 10–12 PDT
- Wed 8/12 9–11 PDT
\If none of those work I can send over a Calendly link.
\Thanks,
\Marissa Cole
